steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') })()

steps.name: seed-item-history
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setItems([{ id: 'seed-sofa', defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [3, 3], rotation: 0, props: {} }]); s.pushHistory() })()

steps.name: start-progress
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); window.__pid = s.notify.start({ title: 'Importing…', kind: 'progress' }); s.notify.update(window.__pid, { progress: 0.42, message: '42 / 100' }) })()

steps.name: log-progress-width
steps.eval: (() => { const seg = document.querySelector('[role="progressbar"] .bud-seg'); console.log('PROBE progress-width', seg && seg.style.width) })()

steps.name: open-location-modal
steps.eval: window.__store.setState({ locationPromptDismissed: false, location: null, onboardingOpen: false, tourOpen: false })

steps.name: log-modal-width
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.modal-overlay > .panel'); console.log('PROBE modal-width', p && getComputedStyle(p).width) })()
